newsitem.title: USA: Intile Designs in deal for offering.
newsitem.headline: Intile Designs in deal for offering.

text.p: Intile Designs Inc said on Tuesday it has signed a tentative agreement for a proposed public stock offering to raise between $5 million and $7 million.
The company said it intends to file a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission in the next 30 to 90 days.
A company spokesman said the company to handle the underwriting is a new stock exchange member firm, but the name of the firm could not be disclosed.
Proceeds from the offering will be used for acquisitions and for general corporate purposes, the spokesman said.
